turns.question: Which suppliers have total balance greater than twice their latest AP invoice?

row_snapshot.sql: SELECT p.id,p.code,TRIM(CONCAT(COALESCE(p.first_name,''),' ',COALESCE(p.last_name,''))),r.organization_id,r.currency_id,r.outstanding,r.invoice_number,r.invoice_date,r.amount_due,r.amount_settled,r.amount_due-r.amount_settled FROM (SELECT i.*,SUM(GREATEST(i.amount_due-i.amount_settled,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY i.party_id,i.organization_id,i.currency_id) outstanding,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.party_id,i.organization_id,i.currency_id ORDER BY i.invoice_date DESC,i.id DESC) seq FROM finance_invoices i WHERE i.type='ap' AND i.status<>'voided' AND i.currency_id IS NOT NULL) r JOIN core_parties p ON p.id=r.party_id WHERE r.seq=1 AND r.outstanding>2*r.amount_due AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.type LIKE '%supplier%'

turns.question: Show accepted quotations not fully delivered or invoiced.
excludes: No terminal code or name matches

row_snapshot.sql:
SELECT q.id,q.organization_id,q.sq_number,q.status,q.converted_so_id,s.so_number,s.status order_status,
CASE WHEN q.converted_so_id IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN s.id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sales_order_lines l WHERE l.sales_order_id=s.id) THEN NULL ELSE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sales_order_lines l WHERE l.sales_order_id=s.id AND (l.fulfilled_quantity IS NULL OR l.fulfilled_quantity<l.quantity)) END all_lines_fulfilled,
CASE WHEN q.converted_so_id IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN s.id IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sales_order_lines l WHERE l.sales_order_id=s.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sales_order_lines l WHERE l.sales_order_id=s.id AND (l.fulfilled_quantity IS NULL OR l.fulfilled_quantity<l.quantity)) OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sales_goods_issue_notes g WHERE g.sales_order_id=s.id AND g.status='completed') THEN 0 ELSE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sales_goods_issue_notes g WHERE g.sales_order_id=s.id AND g.status='completed' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM finance_invoices i WHERE i.source_document_type='sales_order' AND i.source_document_id=s.id AND i.dispatch_document_type='gin' AND i.dispatch_document_id=g.id AND i.type='ar' AND i.status!='voided' AND i.amount_due>=0)) END all_completed_dispatches_invoiced,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_goods_issue_notes g WHERE g.sales_order_id=q.converted_so_id AND g.status='completed') completed_dispatch_count,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM finance_invoices i WHERE i.source_document_type='sales_order' AND i.source_document_id=q.converted_so_id AND i.type='ar' AND i.status!='voided' AND i.amount_due>=0) linked_nonvoid_ar_documents
FROM sales_quotations q LEFT JOIN sales_orders s ON s.id=q.converted_so_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
WHERE q.status IN ('accepted','converted') AND q.deleted_at IS NULL
HAVING all_lines_fulfilled IS NULL OR all_lines_fulfilled=0 OR all_completed_dispatches_invoiced IS NULL OR all_completed_dispatches_invoiced=0
ORDER BY q.id LIMIT 500
